### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Biotech]** **[Functional phenotyping of ADPKD cysts via 23Na MRI]** — *[Preprint](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359242)*
  * Researchers developed a non-invasive $1.8\text{-fold}$ more frequent 7-Tesla sodium ($^{23}\text{Na}$) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) method to phenotype autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) cysts *in vivo*.
  * The imaging revealed two distinct cyst types: high-$[\text{Na}^+]$ cysts, which express the proximal tubular marker SGLT2, and low-$[\text{Na}^+]$ cysts, which express distal tubule/collecting duct markers and exclusively express the vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R)—the therapeutic target of tolvaptan.
  * Marked interindividual variation in cyst composition was observed, with low-$[\text{Na}^+]$ cysts comprising between 4.6% and 83.9% of all cysts, offering a potential functional biomarker to stratify patient response to V2R antagonists.

* **[Digital biomarkers for Multiple Sclerosis motor-cognitive planning]** — *[Preprint](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359238)*
  * Luria's fist-edge-palm paradigm was digitized into a self-administered smartphone task within the Neurological Functional Test Suite (NeuFun-TS) to evaluate 296 participants (including 208 people with MS).
  * A parsimonious two-biomarker composite differentiated disease severity (healthy donors < relapsing-remitting MS < progressive MS), demonstrating strong correlation with MRI-measured CNS tissue destruction ($\rho = 0.29\text{–}0.38$) and clinician disability scales ($\rho = 0.44\text{–}0.52$).
  * Kinematic decomposition successfully dissociated cognitive planning latency from pure motor execution speed during the sequencing tasks.

* **[Translational progress in Alzheimer's disease biomarkers and cognitive tracking]** — *[Preprints](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359341)*
  * *Consensus Risk Modeling*: Utilizing plasma biomarker measurements from 472 participants in the Louisville Twins Study, a consensus framework successfully integrated predictions from three independent machine learning models (using A4-MSD and ADNI-derived assays) to map amyloid risk and centiloid burden while quantifying classification uncertainty. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359341)
  * *Temporal Pole Dynamics*: Source-reconstructed MEG recordings from 29 MCI and 32 healthy controls revealed that episodic-memory impairment in MCI is associated with a reversed, pathological relationship with left-temporal-pole-initiated neuronal avalanches (aperiodic whole-brain activity cascades), which also tracked hippocampal atrophy. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359001)
  * *Remote Testing Confounders*: A 12-week remote study (n=329) using the neotivTrials platform demonstrated that acute within-person changes in sleep duration and subjective mental well-being are significantly associated with weekly delayed associative memory (Object-in-Room Recall) scores, indicating these parameters must be accounted for in remote digital clinical trials. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.29.26359263)

* **[Translational Briefs: Small vessel disease imaging, trial design simulation, and molecular biology]** — *[Preprints / PubMed]*
  * *Cerebral Small Vessel Disease*: The machine learning framework RADAR-WMH was validated on quantitative relaxometry and diffusion-weighted MRI to identify microstructural white matter pathology (myelin loss, axonal injury, extracellular water) extending beyond radiologically visible FLAIR lesions. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359145)
  * *Epilepsy Trial Modeling*: Using the CHOCOLATES simulator (100,000 virtual participants), investigators showed that dropping seizure detection device sensitivity from 100% to 10% inflates placebo median percentage change from 14.7% to 48.1% due to regression-to-the-mean, showing how diagnostic device limitations alter apparent placebo responses. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359361)
  * *Decentralized TBI Modeling*: A privacy-preserving federated learning infrastructure established between TRACK-TBI (US) and CENTER-TBI (Europe/Israel) successfully evaluated and updated IMPACT prognostic models for traumatic brain injury outcomes without requiring cross-border raw patient data sharing. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359337)
  * *Sirtuin Pharmacology*: A review outlines context-dependent sirtuin pharmacology in oncology, focusing on metabolic-epigenetic switches and precision therapeutic targeting. [Link](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42543141/)
  * *Ferroptosis Inhibition*: Research identified two stress-responsive kinases that actively suppress ferroptosis by triggering antioxidant pathways under mild oxidative stress. [Link](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42543384/)
  * *In Silico Oncology*: Computational docking identified novel isatin derivatives as potential multi-target anticancer agents targeting VEGFR-2, EGFR, and caspase-6. [Link](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42542991/)
  * *Molecular Diagnostics*: A Cas12a/crRNA-catalyzed triple self-priming cascade amplification method was developed for sensitive and reliable drug-resistance gene analysis. [Link](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42543449/)

---

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Baricitinib demonstrates clinical efficacy in Phase IIa inflammatory myopathy study]** — *[Preprint](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359332)*
  * A randomized, 1:1 delayed-start Phase IIa trial (NCT04208464) evaluated the oral JAK 1/2 inhibitor baricitinib (Eli Lilly) in 15 adult patients with active dermatomyositis or polymyositis.
  * After 24 weeks of active treatment, 14/15 (93%) of patients achieved the primary outcome of minimal improvement (Total Improvement Score [TIS] >20), with 60% achieving moderate (TIS40) and 13% major (TIS60) clinical response.
  * Significant improvements in CDASI skin activity, patient global scores, pain, fatigue, and physical functioning were observed at 12 weeks, with no drug-related serious adverse events reported.

* **[Biotech]** **[Exploratory analysis identifies candidate FGF/FGFR biomarkers for gunagratinib]** — *[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42542997/)*
  * An exploratory analysis of two early-phase clinical trials evaluated gunagratinib (InnoCare Pharma), a pan-FGFR inhibitor, in patients with recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer.
  * The study identified specific FGF/FGFR alteration types as candidate enrichment biomarkers to select patients likely to derive benefit from the therapy.

* **[Biotech]** **[Population PK comparability achieved for bevacizumab biosimilar CT-P16]** — *[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42542998/)*
  * A population pharmacokinetic study demonstrated PK comparability between CT-P16 (Celltrion's biosimilar candidate) and both EU-approved and US-licensed Avastin (bevacizumab) in healthy subjects and patients with non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.

---

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **[Liposomal bupivacaine evaluated in placebo-controlled post-op analgesia trial]** — *[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42542999/)*
  * A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial evaluated liposomal bupivacaine (Pacira BioSciences) incisional infiltration for postoperative analgesia.
  * The trial assessed the formulation's performance following cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC).

---

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Diverse therapeutic focus characterizes 2026 FDA approvals YTD]** — *[X / @paras_biotech](https://x.com/paras_biotech/status/2083982309955408048)*
  * An analysis of the FDA's 2026 year-to-date (YTD) drug approval class indicates a pivot away from the oncology-centric profile of previous years.
  * The 2026 cohort shows wider therapeutic diversification, with multiple approvals distributed across cardiometabolic disease, immunology, rare disease, and infectious disease.

---

### Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca in rumored megadeal talks with Bristol Myers Squibb]** — *[X / @bradloncar](https://x.com/bradloncar/status/2083986058299994613)*
  * Rumors surfaced that AstraZeneca ($AZN) has held initial discussions regarding a potential pharmaceutical megadeal with Bristol Myers Squibb ($BMY).
  * Industry analyst Jacob Plieth [commented on X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2084189523479593002) questioning the timing of the rumors, noting they coincide with 12 upcoming pivotal clinical readouts for AstraZeneca's bispecific antibody rilvegostomig (PD-1/TIGIT).

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Michigan Supreme Court clears Eli Lilly insulin pricing probe]** — *[STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/02/michigan-supreme-court-ruling-allows-probe-into-lilly-insulin-pricing/?utm_campaign=rss)*
  * A ruling by the Michigan Supreme Court has cleared the way for a state investigation into Eli Lilly's insulin pricing.
  * The probe will investigate allegations of "grossly" excessive pricing that forced diabetes patients to ration or forgo their insulin treatments.

---

### Public Health & Policy

* **[Legislative and Regulatory Policy: Senate research shields, state "Right to Try," and clinical AI]** — *[STAT News / Science-Based Medicine]*
  * *Senate Blocks Grant Scrutiny*: A Senate measure has temporarily blocked a White House proposal that aimed to subject federal scientific research grants to political scrutiny and presidential control. [Link](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/02/senate-would-block-white-house-control-over-research-grants/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * *Montana Right-to-Try Expansion*: Montana has passed an expanded "right-to-try" law. Critics argue the law moves beyond federal boundaries, opening up avenues to commercialize unproven Phase I therapeutics and whittling away the FDA's regulatory authority. [Link](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/montanas-new-right-to-try-opening-the-door-to-profit-from-unproven-drugs/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=montanas-new-right-to-try-opening-the-door-to-profit-from-unproven-drugs)
  * *AI Medical Licensure*: Leadership from the Federation of State Medical Boards published perspectives on the legal, safety, and licensing hurdles associated with certifying AI systems to practice medicine. [Link](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/03/ai-doctors-licensing-state-medical-boards/?utm_campaign=rss)

* **[Wastewater, Infection, and Consumer Health Surveillance]** — *[Preprints]*
  * *Wastewater Recovery Columns*: Engineers validated the "PureBioX Xpurify Column," which utilizes a hydrophobic pre-filtration layer and sequential glass fiber filters to process 1.58 times more wastewater than standard columns while removing RT-PCR inhibitors, significantly enhancing SARS-CoV-2 detection sensitivity. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359326)
  * *Four-Drug MDA Success*: A combined mass drug administration (MDA) of ivermectin, diethylcarbamazine, albendazole, and azithromycin in Papua New Guinea resulted in a 49% reduction in lymphatic filariasis circulating filarial antigen (CFA) positivity and a 78% reduction in scabies prevalence after one year. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359257)
  * *E-Cigarette Safety Issues*: A computational textual analysis of 10.4 million Reddit posts from `r/electronic_cigarette` identified that 53.4% of consumer "cause phrases" were linked to health issues, with lipoid pneumonia (5.9%), general pneumonia (4.1%), and nausea (2.7%) emerging as the primary self-reported health concerns. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.29.26359262)

* **[Clinical Trial Quality, Ethics, and Cost-Effectiveness]** — *[Preprints / STAT News]*
  * *Stroke Reversal Algorithms*: A retrospective analysis of anticoagulation-associated intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) showed that "Code Stroke" activation reduced door-to-treatment time from 277 minutes to 64 minutes. However, warfarin use caused significant delays versus DOACs due to waiting for INR results and weight-based 4F-PCC calculations, suggesting the need for immediate, fixed-dose 4F-PCC reversal protocols. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.29.26359285)
  * *Amyloid-Targeting Cost-Effectiveness*: A microsimulation study based on the Amsterdam Dementia Cohort showed that at a list price of €22,600/year, the ICER of amyloid-targeting Alzheimer's therapies was €39,745/QALY if the treatment effect did not wane over time, but ballooned to €151,016/QALY with a 20% annual effect waning rate. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26359218)
  * *Automated Reporting Auditing*: Investigators validated "RegCheck," an LLM-based workflow designed to audit clinical trial reports against registry protocols. RegCheck achieved an 85.6% raw accuracy (improving to 94.8% after resolving human benchmarking errors) in detecting outcome misreporting, at an average cost of $5.94 per paper. [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.26358885)
  * *Heart Transplant Prehab*: Clinicians launched an inpatient "prehabilitation" physical therapy program designed to prevent physical decline and improve outcomes for fragile, hospitalized patients awaiting heart transplants. [Link](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/03/heart-transplant-prehabilitation-cardiologist-discusses-innovative-project/?utm_campaign=rss)

---

### Worth watching
* **AstraZeneca / Bristol Myers Squibb M&A Rumors**: While highly speculative, a deal of this scale would reshuffle the oncology, cardiovascular, and immunology landscape. Watch closely for whether this is a distraction tactic or a genuine play ahead of AZN's upcoming 12 pivotal readouts for the bispecific antibody **rilvegostomig**.

- Pure Science
    - [Is spider silk really stronger than steel?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wt4p2oalmRY) -- Veritasium
        - The video evaluates the tensile strength and toughness of spider silk compared to steel and Kevlar, explaining how its underlying nanostructure, chemistry, water content, and spinning process determine its mechanical properties.
        - Spiders cannot be farmed on an industrial scale due to territorial and cannibalistic behaviors, preventing direct harvesting of natural spider silk in large quantities.
        - To produce spider silk at scale, researchers and companies like Kraig Biocraft Laboratories use genetic engineering and CRISPR technology to create transgenic silkworms that express spider silk proteins.
        - The practical strength and real-world viability of engineered transgenic spider silk are evaluated through material testing and a practical load-bearing swing test.
